objects.ReviewerAssignment: reviewId + actor identity + permission proof ref

read_model: FormalReviewReadService serves Review workflow and prior effective decision separately, using analytical compare UI adapters.
invariants: Open re-review does not erase prior effective Decision
Actor display label is not institutional reviewer authority
Review criteria are pinned at request, not latest policy alias

epistemic.empty: No assigned reviews: show request/queue filters, not fabricated reviewer role.
epistemic.stale: Evidence revision changed during review: continue pinned basis or explicit new review request.
epistemic.unavailable: Authority registry unavailable: inspect allowed; decision unavailable with reason.
epistemic.error: Stale expected decision returns conflict and preserves findings.
